name: Ai Shimai ~Futari no Kajitsu~
source:
Taketo is the only son of the President of Nogawa Industries, a well known and powerful corporation, which is said to be in a connection with the yakuza. One day, Taketo going on his usual way to the company's building for begging money from his father, witnesses how this father's car has a traffic accident with a young woman named Kitazawa Yukie. Being in a hurry on his way to an airport, his father uses the occasion to put his good for nothing son to the test by letting him handle the litigation. If he wants money, he will have to settle the case amicably by making the woman his by any means necessary. If he can do that, he will also introduce him to his shady business that he had refused until now by lack of trust. 
Now Taketo has only four days before his father's returning to meet his expectations.
translation:
武人是實力雄厚、據說與黑道有關的野川產業社長獨子。一天，他照常前往公司向父親討錢，途中目睹父親的汽車與名叫北澤雪繪的年輕女性發生車禍。父親正急著趕往機場，便藉機考驗這個不成器的兒子，把這樁糾紛丟給他處理。武人若想拿到錢，就必須不擇手段把那個女人變成自己的人，以此達成和解。若能成功，父親還會讓他接觸過去因不信任而不肯交給他的遊走灰色地帶的生意。
距離父親回來只剩四天，武人必須在期限內滿足他的要求。
